contract.purpose: Provide Node-compatible MyGRACE CLI and MCP-equivalent operations inside the Reasonix runtime.
contract.scope: Implement init, lint, module, phase, verification, and file markup operations without requiring Bun on the critical path.

compatibility.compat-1: Output remains close enough to upstream MyGRACE CLI for user recognition.
compatibility.compat-2: Bun CLI may remain available as optional fallback, not as required runtime dependency.
